headline: US-Iran military standoff escalates near Strait of Hormuz
raw_text: Heightened naval activity between US and Iranian forces near the Strait of Hormuz has raised fears of a shipping disruption. Brent crude jumped over 8% intraday as traders priced in transit risk.

headline: US Treasury expands sanctions targeting Iranian crude exports and shadow fleet
raw_text: New OFAC designations target vessels and intermediaries allegedly facilitating Iranian crude sales, adding compliance risk for buyers of blended Gulf cargoes.

headline: Houthi forces claim missile attack on tanker in southern Red Sea
raw_text: A commercial tanker reported a near-miss missile strike transiting the Bab-el-Mandeb strait, prompting several shipping majors to again suspend Red Sea transits in favor of the Cape of Good Hope route.

headline: OPEC+ signals possible emergency production adjustment amid demand uncertainty
raw_text: OPEC+ delegates hinted at a potential emergency meeting to discuss coordinated output changes in response to the escalating Gulf security situation.
